framing: Not a forecast. Most parameters are scenario values (class d) with ranges but no measured distribution. Primary result: does each claim hold at every point of the box of the paper's own stated ranges, and if not, where does it fail. Shares of draws are secondary: uniform over the stated ranges, log-uniform for kappa_2025 (an assumption, not a measured distribution); the anchor dimensions follow the firm-cluster bootstrap within its 90% interval.
